title: A highlight of our Andalusia adventures
text: We had Lautaro (LT) the Argentinian gaucho is our guide. He was fantastic. This truly was an adventure as he more or less took us around the entire city of Granada, with fantastic views, learning a ton of history, and just generally having a fun time.  The Pionono was awesome.
author: gylm2016

title: Fantastic Tour of Albaicin with Mario
text: We had an amazing tour of the Albaicín in Granada with Mario. He was incredibly fun, engaging, and full of fascinating knowledge about the area. His stories and insights brought the neighborhood to life, and he made the entire experience both entertaining and truly worthwhile. We couldn’t have asked for a better guide. Highly recommended!
author: Yaury_J

title: Great night walking tour
text: Mario was a great tour guide and we learned a lot about the history and people of Granada. Lots of beautiful photo opportunities
author: Heather_K

title: Great experience!
text: Mario is a great tour guide. We upgraded from the hike to the Segway tour and it was so much fun. Really gabz great, especially for young people!!!

title: Great experience!
text: Alex was an excellent guide!  We learned so much about Granada because he was so knowledgeable!  We highly recommend this tour!
author: Susan_F

title: High energy-lots of history
text: Our guide was very knowledgeable and provided us with historical and cultural information. He answered all of our questions and was very pleasant to be with. His energy and enthusiasm was contagious for everyone in the group. Would definitely come again and have a different tour with him.
author: bettytY3303YF

title: Beautiful places 😍
text: Great visit! You see beautiful places and details avoiding all the people. 2 very pleasant hours. The guide, Alejandro, a 10, very close and gives super useful information for the rest of days.
author: estherlX5749OY

title: Very entertaining walk through Grenada's history
text: Our walking tour with Javier was fantastic: entertaining, informative, and really engaging. It was just the right amount of context and hill climbing (Grenda is steep!). We walked away with a much better understanding of the city's history and architecture - and a sense that we'd discovered a few hidden gems, too. I will caution that the tour description was misleading. This was a simple walking tour that ended before dusk. But if that's what you're looking for you can't go wrong booking this one.
author: Maris_M

title: Lovely sunset tour with a great guide
text: We were changed to the sunset tour for some reason, but Mario our sunset tour guide was great, friendly, and knowledgeable and took us thru the Albazin and Sacromonte.
author: HeidiLynn_T

title: Great adventure night tour
text: Alex our guide was very informative and entertaining. We got to see areas we would never have found on our own. The highlight was seeing the sunset from st.michel church and then the forest walk with the torches and seeing it from the other side of the valley. You will need sturdy shoes and a reasonable fitness level as part of the tour is uphill on dirt paths!
author: Jaclyn C
